data.text: Criterion 1 on KAD-9 - tests written first and seen to fail - has nothing to attach to: the deliverable is a checklist, not code. Unchecked on purpose rather than ticked to make the row green. What stands in for it is criterion 7: the list was run against 0.7.0 before 0.7.0 shipped, and it caught a missing dist/reference.json on the first pass.
